jobs.description:
About Kassow Robots

At Kassow Robots, we develop and produce cutting-edge 7-axis collaborative robots (cobots) designed to offer extraordinary maneuverability and precision in industrial automation. As a dynamic subsidiary of Bosch Rexroth, we combine the agility and innovation of a robotics venture with the stability and global reach of a world leader in drive and control technologies.

We are looking for a dedicated and quality-conscious Assembly Operator to join our production team in Copenhagen. In this role, you will be directly involved in assembling, integrating, and testing the next generation of industrial cobots.

Role Summary

As an Assembly Operator, you will play a hands-on, critical role in transforming mechanical and electrical components into high-precision, industrial-grade collaborative robots. Working closely with our production technicians, quality specialists, and engineering teams, you will ensure every robot leaving our facility meets strict performance, safety, and reliability standards.

Key Responsibilities

Mechatronic Assembly & Integration

• 
Assemble complex mechanical, electromechanical, and electronic sub-assemblies (e.g., robot joints, motors, gearboxes, cable harnesses, and end-of-arm interfaces) strictly following standard operating procedures (SOPs) and Bills of Materials (BOM).

• 
Safely and accurately operate specialized assembly tools, including calibrated torque wrenches, manual/pneumatic press tools, fixtures, and delicate hand tools.

• 
Perform precision wiring, connector assembly, cable routing, and sealing according to electro-mechanical schematics and electrostatic discharge (ESD) prevention protocols.

Inspection & Quality Assurance

• 
Perform incoming and in-process visual and dimensional inspections of parts against technical drawings and internal specifications.

• 
Identify, document, and segregate non-conforming parts or sub-assemblies to prevent defective components from entering the build line.

• 
Maintain complete and accurate traceability records (e.g., serial numbers, batch tracking, torque logs) in the production tracking system.

Functional Testing & Calibration

• 
Assist in executing end-of-line (EOL) functional tests, electrical safety checks, and basic robot commissioning sequences.

• 
Monitor test runs for joint performance, thermal behavior, vibration, or unexpected noise, reporting deviations immediately.

Continuous Improvement & Workshop Organization

• 
Collaborate actively with the R&D and manufacturing engineering teams to provide feedback on manufacturability, assembly sequence improvements, and tool optimization.

• 
Maintain a clean, organized, and safe workplace according to 5S methodology and company health and safety standards.

**Qualifications & Competencies

**

Required Experience & Skills

• 
Technical Background: Vocational training or proven practical experience in mechanical assembly, electro-mechanical assembly, industrial automation, mechatronics, or a related field.

• 
Tool Competency: Proven experience working with calibrated torque wrenches, precision hand tools, alignment fixtures, and press-fitting equipment.

• 
Technical Literacy: Ability to read and interpret technical documentation, assembly manuals, mechanical drawings, and wiring diagrams.

• 
Process Discipline: High attention to detail with an uncompromising commitment to quality, accuracy, and adherence to standardized work instructions.

• 
Languages: Professional working proficiency in English (spoken and written) is required as English is our working language.

Preferred / Nice-to-Have

• 
Prior experience in robotics, automated machinery, aerospace, medical device, or automotive precision manufacturing.

• 
Knowledge of ESD-sensitive electronics handling and clean-assembly practices.

• 
Basic understanding or conversational ability in Danish.

• 
Basic familiarity with ERP/MES systems or digital work instruction software.

**Who you are

**

• 
Detail-Oriented & Quality-Minded: You take pride in high-precision craftsmanship and understand that reliability is non-negotiable in robotics.

• 
Team Player: You enjoy working in a collaborative, international environment where team members support each other to meet production targets.

• 
Problem-Solver: You are curious, proactive, and willing to speak up when you spot opportunities to improve assembly steps or product quality.

**What we offer

**

• 
The opportunity to work at the forefront of modern robotics in a collaborative and tech-savvy environment.

• 
The agility and flat hierarchy of a high-growth tech company, backed by the solid foundation and long-term perspective of the Bosch Group.

• 
Modern manufacturing facilities with ergonomic workstations and high-standard equipment.

• 
A supportive, international team culture with opportunities for continuous learning and personal development.

• 
Competitive salary package and employment conditions.

Application Process

If you are eager to contribute to building the future of collaborative robotics, we would love to hear from you. Please submit your CV and a brief cover letter outlining your relevant assembly experience.

Senior Software Developer

Do you want to write code that genuinely matters when it counts the most? As a Senior Software Developer at Systematic, you will help build mobile software that gives field commanders real-time situational awareness - software that has to work under pressure, on devices in the field, when there is no room for confusion.

**The job

**You will join the Mobile programme, which develops software for mounted and dismounted commanders in the field. The solutions run on vehicles and handheld devices, implement resilient network protocols so frontline units share a common operational picture, and expose APIs that let customers integrate sensors and drones.

You will work across a full-stack codebase with a frontend in Angular and a backend in Java, troubleshooting and solving complex problems while shaping new features in close collaboration with domain experts, a UX designer, and a software architect. As a senior developer, you will go beyond day-to-day delivery to help shape the technical direction of the solution over time - contributing to architectural and maintainability improvements, and supporting your colleagues through code reviews and technical sparring. You will also play a key role in strengthening the team's engineering practices and ways of working.

Joining the team

You will be part of a small, focused scrum team based in Aarhus - currently three developers, a tester, and an architect, spanning a range of experience levels that makes for genuine knowledge-sharing in both directions. The team is part of a larger Mobile programme spanning seven scrum teams across Denmark and Romania, giving you access to a broad community of colleagues while still working in a setting where your contributions are visible and valued. The team has worked together for three years and has built a collaborative, open culture where ideas and feedback are actively encouraged.

**Your qualifications

**We are looking for someone with a bachelor's or master's degree in software engineering or a related field, and solid, hands-on experience from a professional software development team. What matters most to us is that you can navigate and take ownership of complex tasks in an existing codebase, and that you understand how to design and structure software beyond just making it work.

Experience with Java and Angular is a strong advantage, since it is what we work with day to day - but it is not a must. If you come from another strongly typed, object-oriented language such as C#, and are motivated to make the jump to Java, that is very welcome too. Furthermore, you...

•    Are proactive, open to feedback, and comfortable communicating actively with colleagues and stakeholders

•    Offer help as readily as you ask for it, and care about writing code of good quality

•    Are fluent in written and spoken English

Please note that you must be able to present a clean criminal record and have lived in a NATO and/or EU country for the past seven years, as we work with security-classified projects. Read more here.

Welcome to Systematic Aarhus

At our Aarhus office, you can look forward to joining our Employees Club, which offers nearly 100 events a year of both social and professional character. Here, you can take advantage of a range of on-site perks from physiotherapist-led massages and an in-house hairdresser to sports clubs, game tables, and even our own padel court. Our canteen is a standout feature, serving a daily selection of delicious and healthy dishes. Beyond the office, you will also enjoy benefits like free ARoS +1 access and various shopping discounts.

Never stop developing

Systematic is uniquely people-centric, truly international, and proudly rooted in Denmark with more than 1,100 employees. Together, we write intelligent and innovative code to drive progress and improve lives. We develop IT solutions that make a real difference where it matters most. This is why we never stop developing. Here, there is room to be professional and personal. It is not just a place to work but a place to belong.

Start your development here

We will be assessing applications on an ongoing basis as we wish to welcome our new colleague as soon as possible, so click Apply Now and send us your CV today. If you have any questions, you are always welcome to contact us on tel. +45 8943 2000 and ask for Nikolaj Lysbjerg Molzen.

jobs.occupation: Do You Have a Passion for Strategic People-Centred Management Consulting and Digital Transformation?
jobs.description:
With more than 3,000 employees, Deloitte is the largest audit and consultancy firm in Denmark. We tailor solutions across Audit, Tax, Financial Advisory Services, Enterprise Risk Services, Technology and Transformations.

Deloitte Technology & Transformation is seeking an ambitious Analyst/Consultant with a passion for strategic people-centred management consulting and digital transformation. If you’re ready to apply your expertise and make an impact, we’d love to hear from you!

About the team

Who will you be working with?

You will join Deloitte’s evolving HR Strategy & Technology practice within Deloitte Consulting (Technology & Transformation) as an analyst or consultant (level dependent on experience).

You will be part of our strategy and operations community where we focus on the advisory side of HR transformation. We help clients reimagine their HR functions and operating models by combining strategic thinking with operational excellence. From leading complex end-to-end HR transformations to advising on the latest human capital trends and best practices, our consultants collaborate closely with senior HR professionals to align organizations with strategic goals, optimize HR processes, and gain a competitive edge.

If you're passionate about making a difference on the people side of strategy in a collaborative, international environment, seize this opportunity to apply for a full-time position with Deloitte's HR Strategy & Technology team.

Job Description

What work will you be doing?

Emphasizing growth and impact, our team cultivates a supportive culture where everyone can thrive. Through social activities and collaboration within our team and across Deloitte, we prioritize delivering results for our clients while fostering a supportive environment. As an Analyst/Consultant, you will collaborate closely with experienced consultants on client projects, contributing to HR strategy and transformation initiatives for multinational corporations. Additionally, you will support business development efforts and contribute to internal initiatives such as employer branding and learning programs based on your interests and background.

In this role, you will make an impact by:

• Approach each engagement as a collaborative case — diagnosing client needs through stakeholder interviews and organizational analysis, leveraging AI and data-driven insights, and co-creating solutions with HR leaders and business stakeholders.

• Develop comprehensive HR strategies aligned with organisational goals and objectives, collaborating closely with clients, management teams, and stakeholders through meetings and and workshops.

• Conducting research, data collection, and analysis to provide valuable insights to clients,

• Collaborating with project teams to develop high-quality deliverables, including documents and presentations, for client projects.

Qualifications

Who we are looking for?

We’re looking for a curious and analytical thinker who enjoys crafting creative solutions to complex challenges. You communicate your ideas clearly and confidently, helping others understand and embrace your advice. You value close collaboration with clients and enjoy working in fast-paced, diverse, and multidisciplinary teams.

You have the following skills and experience:

• A Master’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Strategy, IT, or a related field.

• Good interpersonal skills, workshop facilitation, and a collaborative approach to teamwork

• A genuine interest in human capital strategies and strategic organisational development.

We are particularly interested in candidates who also bring:

• Outstanding academic achievement.

• Experience within HR transformation and HR life-cycle processes.

• Experience from the consulting industry.

Even if you do not see yourself in all the bullets above, we encourage you to apply if you believe your skills can contribute to our team’s success**.

Additional Information

We're looking for someone who can start as soon as possible. If you're ready to make an impact immediately, we'd love to hear from you.

To apply, please upload your resume, bachelor's and master's degree transcripts, and any other relevant documents through our application portal.

Instead of a traditional cover letter, we request that you respond to the following two questions, with each answer limited to a maximum of 200 words. These responses will provide us with a deeper understanding of your qualifications and interest in the role:

• What interests and motivates you about pursuing a career in HR Strategy & Technology consulting, and what unique contributions do you envision bringing to this role?

• How have your educational and/or professional experiences prepared you to work as an Analyst/Consultant at Deloitte?

We process applications and arrange interviews continually, so we recommend that you apply as soon as possible.

We encourage all candidates to apply for the position regardless of, e.g., age, gender (gender identity and gender expression), sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, nationality, or disability.

By applying for this job, you will be assessed against the Deloitte Global Talent Standards. We have designed these standards to provide a consistent and exceptional Deloitte employee experience globally.

We look forward to connecting with you!

In Deloitte, you will find passionate, caring people who are curious by nature and striving to evolve. We value our different skills, perspectives and experiences and foster an environment where innovative powers thrive. To us, success is the feeling that the work we are doing will outlast us. The impact we make is not about what we achieve as individuals, but how we enable those around us to be their very best. From professional development to leadership opportunities, we empower our people to be extraordinary by playing to their strengths – because that is how we can make a difference.

Do you want to work on some of the most complex bridge, tunnel and marine structures in Denmark and internationally? Are you passionate about concrete design and motivated by solving challenging engineering problems? Do you want to be apart of an international frontrunner in major structures? Then this could be your next opportunity at COWI.

At COWI, we are looking for a Senior Concrete Design Specialist to strengthen our expertise within complex concrete structures and large infrastructure projects within major bridges, large tunnels, marine structures. You will become part of a highly skilled team working across disciplines and geographies, delivering solutions that make a lasting difference to the way people and societies connect

Turn challenges into sustainable solutions

As a Senior Concrete Design Specialist, you will play a key role in the design and delivery of major infrastructure projects. You will work with complex concrete structures where sound engineering judgement, technical expertise and close collaboration are essential. You will contribute to projects from early concept and design through to detailed design and construction support, working closely with colleagues, clients, contractors and other project stakeholders.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Leading and performing structural design of complex concrete structures

• Supporting project teams with technical advice, reviews and engineering assessments

• Collaborating with structural, geotechnical, architectural and other engineering disciplines

• Participating in client dialogue and technical discussions with contractors and project partners

• Contributing to technical development, knowledge sharing and continuous improvement within our concrete and structural engineering community

• Supporting the development of less experienced engineers and sharing your expertise across the organisation

Your skills. Our team. Together, we design the future.

To succeed in this role, you have a strong technical background in structural engineering and extensive experience with concrete design and major structures. You are comfortable working on complex projects where technical challenges require both specialist knowledge and practical engineering judgement. Experience from projects such as bridges, tunnels, marine structures, transportation infrastructure, large foundations or other complex concrete structures will be highly relevant.

On top of that you have:

• A Master degree in Civil or Structural Engineering is preferred or a similar discipline

• Significant professional experience with structural design from civil infrastructure projects.

• Strong knowledge of structural design principles, analysis and relevant design standards such as Instance Eurocode 2

• Strong communication and collaboration skills

• Experience working in multidisciplinary and/or international project teams

• A proactive and solution-oriented approach, with the ability to work independently while contributing actively to a team

A place to work and so much more

At COWI, we work together with our customers to shape a sustainable and liveable world. We do it by applying our knowledge and curiosity – and sometimes even our courage – to create the solutions the world needs today to enable a better tomorrow. We support our customers’ transition towards increased sustainability. We strive to lead by example by embedding environmental management, social responsibility, and good governance into our business practices and the options we provide for our customers. We value differences and development and cultivate an environment of belonging and having fun. Because that is what brings out the best in you, at work and at home. With offices primarily located in Scandinavia, the UK, North America, and India, we are currently more than 7,500 people who bring their expertise in engineering, architecture, energy, and environment into play.

Got more questions?

If you have any unanswered questions about the role or what we have to offer, please reach out to Global Talent Acquisition Partner, Shruti Gupta at srgu@cowi.com or Head of Discipline Major Structures, Rúben Marques Murargi, at rumu@cowi.com Get to know us even better at our website, www.cowi.com, where you can learn more about our projects, our strategy, what we want to achieve and what life is like at COWI.

Diversity is fundamental to COWI, inclusion is key.

We are committed to creating a respectful and fair work environment where all employees have a sense of belonging and equitable opportunities to thrive and grow. We ensure that our leaders are role models for inclusive leadership by cultivating a culture where diverse perspectives and thoughts are seen as strengths. And we take diversity and inclusion into account in all relevant decisions and processes and when setting up teams and fora. We do it because it is part of our values and because it is simply the right thing to do.

Before you apply

All you need to include in your application is your CV - no photo or application letter. At an interview, you can tell us everything we need to know about why you’re interested in joining COWI. As for the photo, we prefer to form our first impression in person rather than from a picture.

Why join COWI?

• Work on complex Bridge, Tunnel and Marine structures that push the boundaries of engineering, technology and sustainability.

• Get the opportunity to contribute to major international projects with global impact.

• Access international Master Classes and learning opportunities to support your professional development.

• Join a strong international network of 30+ countries, sharing knowledge and expertise across borders.

• Collaborate with 100+ highly skilled colleagues working with Bridge, Tunnel and Marine structures.

• Become part of the COWI community through clubs, events and professional networks.

• Enjoy a strong social culture with activities such as Friday bars, Summer Parties and Christmas lunches.

Job Description

Do you have extensive experience leading large-scale, complex IT engagements and building strong, long-term client relationships? Are you motivated by delivering innovative digital solutions? If so, you could play a key role within our Digital Government Business Unit.

Responsibilities and Technologies

As we continue to expand rapidly in the German public sector market, we are looking for a German-speaking professional who can take responsibility for complex IT deliveries while contributing to the continued development of our client partnerships.

In this role, you will lead large, complex IT engagements and work closely with clients and project teams to ensure high-quality delivery and successful outcomes. You will manage expectations, advise clients, and navigate complex stakeholder environments while building strong client relationships and identifying opportunities to further develop existing collaborations. You will also play an important role in adopting, understanding, and communicating Netcompany’s DNA, delivery model, methodology, and ways of working. Combining strong delivery capabilities with commercial awareness, you will engage with key stakeholders, participate in steering committee meetings, and contribute to the continued growth of our engagements.

Your responsibilites will typically include:

• Leading large, complex IT engagements and ensuring successful delivery, progress, and high-quality outcomes.

• Building strong, long-term relationships with clients and key stakeholders, including participating in steering committee meetings.

• Advising clients, managing expectations, and supporting key decisions throughout the delivery.

• Identifying opportunities to develop and expand existing client engagements and contributing to the commercial growth of established partnerships.

• Coordinating and working closely with project teams and colleagues across Netcompany to ensure successful delivery and continued development of client engagements.

About you

To succeed in this role, you:

• Have a strong technical understanding and extensive experience delivering complex IT projects and solutions.

• Have proven experience leading large and complex IT delivery projects, including projects utilizing agile development methodologies.

• Have a strong commercial awareness and a solid understanding of the German public sector market, combined with the ability to build trust and develop strong client relationships.

• Can advise clients on project deliverables while identifying opportunities to further develop existing collaborations.

• Are fluent in German and English at a full professional level and have strong professional communication skills in an international environment.

Continue developing with us

At Netcompany, we focus on your personal and professional development.

We provide a structured career model that allows you to build on your existing experiences.

When you join us, you will be assigned a personal mentor who will support your development and help you achieve your personal and professional goals. The close relationship with an experienced colleague in management gives you concrete insights into the various business areas and responsibilities that match your interests and desires.

Additionally, you will be enrolled in our internal training programme, Netcompany Academy, where you are offered courses and seminars tailored to you and where you are in your career. All courses are taught by experienced Netcompany colleagues, ensuring that all content is highly relevant and builds upon your professional skills. Partaking alongside colleagues from across the company helps you build a solid network and provides a strong foundation for your career at Netcompany, both professionally and socially.

Join an inclusive community

At Netcompany, we highly prioritise an inclusive community. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture based on collaboration and mutual trust, where there is always an opportunity for sparring.

As part of our culture and values, all employees, regardless of background, identity, and experience, are met with understanding and respect and given equal opportunities for development and well-being.

As we are an international company with offices in many countries, you will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate internationally with colleagues from across the world. We offer a shared environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects. Additionally, we have a wide range of social and professional events that provide you with the best opportunities to expand your network.

Send us an application

Upload your resume and a motivational letter to our recruitment system via the link. If you have unanswered questions, feel free to write to hr.dk@netcompany.com.

All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply regardless of gender, gender expression, sexuality, disability, age, religion and belief, political views, nationality, ethnicity, or social background.

We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment. Our recruitment processes are based on individual merit. If you require any reasonable adjustments or additional support during the interview process, please email our recruiters at reasonableadjustments@netcompany.com for assistance. #LI-SA1

jobs.occupation: Media Buyer/ Paid Social Specialist with a flair for AI
jobs.description:
Who are we?

Intelligent Banker is an award-winning FinTech company that builds comparison sites and remarketing solutions to provide banks with data-driven lead generation, operating in 19 countries worldwide.

What are we looking for?

We're hiring a Media Buyer/Paid Social Specialist to run our campaigns — but this role goes a step further.

We are frontrunners in our field, and we intend to stay that way. We want to continue to build AI into how we buy, test, and optimize paid social.

Our ideal hire combines creative performance marketing with tech know-how to get the most out of every single campaign.

Responsibilities

• 
Launch, manage, and optimize campaigns on paid social

• 
Monitor and act on performance data

• 
Develop ad creatives, copy, and hooks tailored to each platform and market

• 
Ensure campaigns remain compliant with advertising and financial regulations in each country

• 
Design and implement AI-assisted workflows (creative testing, reporting, budget/bid optimization) in partnership with our tech and data teams

Requirements

• 
2+ years of hands-on experience running campaigns on Meta Ads and/or TikTok Ads

• 
Comfortable with building automations or AI agents; using tools like Make, Zapier, n8n, or directly with APIs and scripting

• 
Strong analytical skills and a data-driven approach to decision-making

• 
Confident in managing large-scale advertising budgets

• 
Ability to work across multiple markets and languages

• 
Experience working in the financial or lending sector is a plus

What we offer

• 
Competitive salary

• 
Flexible working hours

• 
Catered lunch

• 
Free coffee, tea, and office snacks

• 
Regular social events and gatherings

• 
An informal, international office environment

• 
Office located near public transit in the heart of Odense C

Sounds like you? Tell us about an AI agent or automation you've built, or a campaign you're especially proud of when you apply.

While this is primarily a full-time position, we're open to part-time schedules of 25 hours or more per week.

Senior Business Partner People & Organization (P&O)

A broad and highly visible P&O role at the heart of Xellia’s global organization

Are you an experienced P&O professional who combines strong business understanding with a pragmatic yet ambitious approach and the ability to get things done?

Xellia Pharmaceuticals is looking for a Senior Business Partner P&O to take on a broad and highly visible role at our Copenhagen headquarters. You will work across both strategic and operational P&O priorities and play an important role in translating Xellia’s strategy into organizational capability, strong leadership practices and pragmatic P&O solutions.

This is a role for someone who enjoys operating in a fast-paced, ambitious and performance-driven international environment. You will interact with senior leaders and executives across the organization and take ownership of several important global P&O processes while remaining close to the day-to-day execution.

In other words, this is not a role where strategy and execution are separated. You will get the opportunity to do both.

Your role

As Senior Business Partner P&O, you will become part of Xellia’s global People & Organization function and work from our headquarters in Copenhagen.

You will act as a trusted sparring partner to senior leaders while taking direct ownership of a broad portfolio of P&O activities. A significant part of your role will be to ensure that processes are not only designed, but implemented, followed through and continuously improved.

Talent Acquisition will be an important part of your role. You will manage selected senior and strategically important recruitments across the organization, covering the process from talent attraction and sourcing through assessment, selection and offer. In addition, you will provide hands-on Talent Acquisition support to the Copenhagen site when needed and contribute to continuously strengthening Xellia’s approach to recruitment and talent attraction.

Your broader responsibilities will include:

• Driving selected global organizational review processes, including succession planning, organizational assessments and input to workforce and capability planning

• Driving the global performance management cycle and supporting leaders on performance-related matters

• Acting as a trusted P&O partner to leaders and providing pragmatic, business-oriented advice

• Driving and developing learning and development initiatives, including implementation of Xellia’s global competency framework

• Supporting leadership development and coordinating relevant leadership training and coaching initiatives

• Contributing to employee engagement activities, including analysis, action planning and follow-up

• Supporting employer branding activities in Copenhagen

• Managing external recruitment, assessment and development partners and ensuring both quality and commercial relevance

• Leading and contributing to global and local P&O projects and new initiatives

You will also play an active role in developing how Xellia uses AI and technology within P&O. This already includes AI-supported tools for job descriptions, job advertisements and structured interview guides, and we expect you to help identify further opportunities where technology can improve quality, speed and the employee and manager experience.

The formal scope spans strategic and operational P&O support, talent acquisition, performance management, organizational development, leadership development and vendor management. We do not expect you to be a unicorn who has mastered every aspect of P&O. We are looking for a passionate and committed professional who sees the opportunity in a broad portfolio of responsibilities and is motivated by taking ownership, creating momentum and successfully juggling the many different priorities the role entails.

Who are you?

We expect you to have a solid background from a senior HR role, ideally from an international and commercially oriented organization where expectations, pace and stakeholder complexity are high.

You probably bring:

• Strong experience within Talent Acquisition, preferably including senior and strategically important recruitments, combined with experience across several broader HR disciplines

• Experience driving organizational processes such as organizational reviews, succession planning, performance management or workforce planning

• Experience working directly with senior leaders and the confidence to challenge constructively when needed

• A strong business mindset and an ability to translate organizational needs into pragmatic solutions

• Experience managing projects and processes across functions and geographies

• An interest in how AI, data and technology can strengthen HR/P&O

• Strong communication skills and professional fluency in English

Experience from pharmaceuticals, life sciences or another highly regulated industry can be an advantage, but is not a prerequisite.

More importantly, you understand what it takes to operate successfully in an international corporate environment with high expectations for quality, responsiveness and execution.

The person we are looking for

Your way of working will be just as important as your HR toolbox.

You are quick-thinking, resourceful and action-oriented, and you naturally create momentum around the activities you own. You are comfortable moving between senior stakeholder discussions and very practical execution – sometimes within the same hour.

You have the maturity and robustness to navigate different perspectives and senior stakeholders in an international organization, and you communicate clearly and confidently.

At the same time, you have a strong hands-on mentality. You take ownership, follow through and do not consider operational tasks beneath your level. You thrive in a role where the breadth is significant, priorities can shift quickly, and delivering high-quality support to the business matters.

A bit about us

Xellia is a 120-year-old company with a refreshingly start-up feel inside. We have spent more than a century at the forefront of anti-infective medicine, making a difference to patients all over the world – and we are just as ambitious today as we were a hundred years ago.

We have recently refreshed our brand around a simple, human idea: We’re Your People. It is built on the strong relationships and trusted partnerships that have always defined Xellia, putting the real Xellians – the warm, expert and dedicated people behind the science – front and center.

Why Xellia?

Because you will be joining at a genuinely exciting moment – with a refreshed brand, real momentum and the rare combination of a 120-year heritage with start-up energy inside. The work matters. The medicines we make help patients in some of the most critical moments of their lives.

For the right person, this role offers a compelling combination of seniority, breadth, international exposure and hands-on responsibility. You will have the opportunity to influence important global P&O processes, work closely with senior stakeholders and help develop how Xellia approaches talent, performance, organizational capability and the use of new technology within P&O.

And because here, you are not just a hire – you are one of us.

We’re Your People. Come and be one of them.

Practical information

The position is based in Copenhagen, Denmark. Workplace presence is expected approximately four days per week, and occasional travel may be required.

Contact and application

The recruitment process is handled by European Search Company on behalf of Xellia Pharmaceuticals. All inquiries are treated confidentially.

For additional information about the position, please contact Christoffer Bjørk Petersen on +45 20 80 16 38 or Brian Ranvits on +45 20 48 05 48.

If you see yourself in the position, please send your application by using the Apply button below.

Software Developer and Consultant for Life Science & Pharma Industry

About DAQUMA

In the summer of 2022, Bjarke, Peter and Sille started a new consultancy supporting life science companies with various elements of IT implementation. DAQUMA is a Technology and Data solution provider that helps life science companies succeed through implementations, data migrations, data integration, data management and quality control.

We believe in flexibility, flat hierarchies, and the freedom to shape both DAQUMA’s journey and your own professional path.

About the role

We are looking for a Software Developer and Consultant to support our Life Science and Pharma clients with the implementation and integration of our platform, DAQUMA:AI.

DAQUMA:AI is built on Microsoft Azure Services, and your role will primarily focus on integrating our platform into clients’ existing enterprise and regulated IT environments.

This is a client-facing consulting role where you will work directly with stakeholders to implement integrations, support deployment activities, and contribute to the technical implementation of our software.

You will:

• Collaborate with clients to understand their IT landscape, workflows, and integration needs.

• Implement and configure IT solutions based on client specifications.

• Design and implement integrations using Azure-native services such as API Management, Logic Apps, and App Services.

• Support the deployment of AI-driven document and data processing solutions.

• Maintain documentation of system configurations, integrations, and mappings.

• Troubleshoot technical issues and provide technical support.

• Conduct onboarding sessions and workshops for clients on DAQUMA:AI.

• Ensure integrations comply with requirements in regulated environments (e.g., GxP).

• Connect and harmonize data across enterprise systems such as Veeva Vault.

• Deliver on and support migration projects and other implementation projects for clients.

About you

You bring:

• A strong consulting mindset and a passion for delivering impactful client solutions.

• Hands-on experience working with the Microsoft Azure cloud platform.

• Experience with system and API integrations in enterprise environments.

• Experience in client-facing implementation or consulting roles.

• Strong communication skills and the ability to engage with both business and IT stakeholders.

• The ability to work independently as well as in collaborative teams.

Experience in one or more of the following areas is a plus:

• Life Science / Pharma industry experience.

• Experience in regulated environments (e.g., GxP).

• Veeva Vault experience.

• Previous consultancy experience.

Are you looking for a role where you can combine theoretical computer vision, hardware integration, and robust software development?

Trackman is looking for a Computer Vision Engineer to join our Golf Launch Monitor R&D team. You will join the team in building high-precision tracking systems engineered to perform reliably in challenging environments and satisfy the highest requirements of elite athletes.

Whether you are a recent graduate or have a couple of years of experience in electrical engineering, computer science, embedded/mechatronics, or related fields, this is an opportunity to build deep technical expertise while working hands-on with some of the most challenging problems in computer vision and sensor technology.

Since 2003, Trackman has been on the forefront of sports tracking technology, combining high-speed cameras, radar, and applied physics. Our products are used daily by professional athletes, coaches, club fitters, and broadcasters worldwide. Staying at the forefront requires more than developing new technology. It means continuously  improving, testing, and hardening existing systems, so they work flawlessly every single day in real-world conditions.

The Role

As a Computer Vision Engineer, you will work across the development lifecycle: running feasibility studies on new optical sensors, helping design real-time tracking pipelines, and taking pride in diagnosing, maintaining, and improving products across demanding deployment environment.

We are looking for motivated engineers who pair a strong theoretical academic foundation with the practical instinct to roll up their sleeves, diagnose tricky integration bottlenecks, and build technology that works.

You will join the Golf Launch Monitors R&D team, a highly skilled, multidisciplinary group of specialists working across computer vision, radar signal processing, mathematical modeling, and software engineering. We are committed to excellence and operate with a first-principles mindset, constantly pushing physical and computational boundaries to ensure our tracking accuracy remains the global benchmark.

Key Responsibilities

• 
Sensor & Hardware Integration: Evaluate next-generation camera sensors, optical setups, and custom illumination; diagnose hardware/software interface edge cases (e.g., latency, frame drops, synchronization).

• 
Algorithm & Pipeline Design: Develop, tune, and profile real-time 2D/3D vision tracking and calibration algorithms capable of handling all kinds of challenging cases.

• 
Production Engineering & Maintenance: Write clean, testable C++ and Python code. Maintain, refactor, and harden existing production codebases to ensure long-term stability and high uptime.

• 
Field-Data Validation: Analyze real-world datasets collected across challenging environments to identify vulnerabilities, eliminate subtle tracking bugs, and continuously raise tracking accuracy.

• 
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with hardware, firmware, and QA teams to translate ambiguous physical challenges into reliable, deployable software solutions.

Who You Are:

• 
You are a recent MSc/PhD graduate or early-career engineer with approximately 0–3 years of experience in Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Applied Mathematics, Physics, or related field.

• 
You have gained hands-on experience with computer vision, sensors, image processing,

• 
You have a strong interest in – areas such as camera sensors, calibration, 3D geometry, feature tracking, or image-processing pipelines.

• 
You have gained experience in software engineering through professional research, or substantial university projects.

• 
You have strong academic or practical skills in C++ and/or Python and care about writing efficient, structured, and maintainable code.

• 
You enjoy solving complex technical problems, digging into code and data, and investigating issues until you understand their root cause.

• 
You are curious, highly motivated, organized, and comfortable taking ownership in a collaborative and informal engineering environment.

Bonus Points For:

Experience or interest in any of the following is an advantage:

• 
High-speed or global-shutter imaging

• 
Embedded Linux or RTOS

• 
Camera-radar sensor fusion

• 
CUDA, SIMD, TensorRT, or similar acceleration technologies

• 
Sports technology, biomechanics, or golf tracking

The Office

We are located at DTU Science Park in Hørsholm. We take great pride in the state-of-art building we have designed! The office features bright meeting rooms, coffee areas to catch up with colleagues, a large testing arena with simulators available for employees and a fitness center, everything surrounded by a beautiful forest and respecting the environment. We made sure to utilize the newest technologies to be energy efficient and be mindful of ventilation and sound propagation. The cherry on top is our canteen: with an indoor and outdoor area to enjoy the fresh food prepared by our own kitchen staff.

Join the home of a powerful sports brand and a one-of-a-kind technology

Our proprietary technology is based on expert knowledge about radar, computer vision, data, and software engineering. Our solutions are developed by specialists who endlessly explore and challenge new technical boundaries. Trackman’s blend of cutting-edge technology, sports, and continued growth make our company an outstanding place to work.

Our work culture is entrepreneurial, ambitious, and rewarding as you get to collaborate with inspiring colleagues and interact with the leaders of golf, baseball, and football. Based on a unique brand reputation, we are proud to work in close partnership with the top athletes, organizations, and teams that rely on our technology to stay ahead of the race.

We are a Danish company founded, owned, and managed since 2003 by three entrepreneurs with a strong passion for sports. Today, we have a global footprint with our headquarters located in Denmark (Hørsholm) and offices in New York, Phoenix, Seoul and Tokyo. We employ over 1000+ people worldwide, half of which work in Denmark, where most hardware and software products are developed, tested, and manufactured.

Where innovation happens

At Trackman, we know that great people make great products. We believe that teams thrive, and innovation sparks in an atmosphere where people are encouraged to think for themselves, where everybody’s voices are heard, and where the best ideas prevail in the pursuit of exceptional solutions. This mix makes Trackman an inspiring company – for our customers and colleagues.

Share our Passion!

Combilent is an entrepreneurial company specializing in the design and manufacture of high-performance solutions in the fields of Land Mobile Radio. Despite employing only 25, Combilent is the preferred supplier of components for critical communication to all the largest OEMs in US and Europe, providing premium and highly advanced components behind communication equipment to first responders such as police and alarm centrals. Being part of the Indutrade Group, a Swedish investment company with a vast network of technical companies, Combilent also benefit from their solid market presence and long-term approach to business, looking to grow organically, providing strong support to the companies in the group. Indutrade is recognized for its focus on sustainable growth and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) strategies, driving sustainable practices across its portfolio of businesses. We are located in Farum, north of Copenhagen and are looking for a:

Sales & Business Development Manager

Business Development – Driving New Business

Combilent has had a solid and profitable business within Land Mobile Radio (LMR) for more than 20 years, and this remains a strong foundation for the company. However, our growth ambitions go beyond LMR. We have built deep expertise and strong relationships as a niche OEM supplier of mechatronics with integrated software and Radio Frequency (RF) technology  and we now want to leverage this platform to build a second leg of business.

Therefore we target to develop an entirely new customer base of OEMs in sectors following today’s major technology trends, while leveraging our position as a niche OEM supplier.

Your job will be to bring new ideas and business opportunities, and open new doors through networking. We offer startup-up speed in combination with access to funding through our owner, and know-how to execute.

You will report to the CEO and work very closely with her and with the founder (CCO) of the company, who plays a pivotal role regarding products and customers.

Key Responsibilities – Building New Ground

In a small entrepreneurial team there will be good opportunities to shape the role, and you will, among other things, be responsible for:

• Identifying and developing new business beyond our current customer base by building relations with new OEM customers in emerging sectors such as Defense, AI, Drones and IoT and expanding into new verticals with current OEM’s through new networking.

• Generating and testing new business ideas through extensive networking outside our current contacts, translating market trends and macro shifts into concrete opportunities for the Combilent

• Building strong relationships and new networks with key customers and partners to generate leads and close new business

• Staying ahead of market trends, emerging technologies, and customer preferences to inform product development and sales strategy

• Building and presenting business cases for new products and market entries, including go-to-market strategies, and resource needs

• Playing an active role at all levels of the business, from high-level strategic discussions to hands-on sales and operational tasks, reflecting the entrepreneurial spirit of Combilent

What You Bring – A Networker and Idea-Generator

Most likely, you hold a degree in Engineering, Business, MBA or related field. You have 5+ years of experience in sales, business management and/or product development, in an industry that is tech focused. You have a hunter profile and get your energy from finding business opportunities and convert them into business. Furthermore, you are experienced in strategic thinking combined with an entrepreneurial mindset, and with the ability to thrive in a small business environment where everyone contributes.

What We Offer – Room to Build Something New

We offer a compensation package that matches your qualifications, including a pension and a bonus scheme, but just as importantly, we offer exciting professional challenges and a team that values openness and good collaboration as well as a culture, where we treat each other well. You will get a key role in a small, innovative company, providing opportunities to make a significant impact on the future direction of the company. You will get autonomy to shape and lead new business ventures, with the opportunity to influence both product development and acquisition strategies.

We review applications continuously and may close the posting at short notice. We encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

Reapplying

If you previously applied but were not invited to an assessment, you may apply again at any time.

If you attended an assessment but were not successful, you are welcome to reapply 24 months after the unsuccesful assessment.

Candidates who progress will participate in the following steps:

• Online Interview with a recruiter

• Online Tests (cognitive and personality assessments)

• Assessment Day — group exercises, simulator session, personal interview

• Final Checks — background screening, security interview, and drug/alcohol testing

Each step of the process might be disqualifying.

Shortlisted applicants can expect assessment invitations during spring/summer 2026, with employment beginning in summer/fall 2026.

Questions?

Contact us at pilotrecruitment@sas.dk.

Disclaimer:

SAS may adjust the recruitment process or base availability at any time. Meeting minimum requirements or passing assessments does not guarantee employment.

All offers depend on mandatory background checks, including security interview, drug and alcohol testing, license validation, and employment verification.

Salary levels follow collective agreements and cannot be negotiated. Approved candidates may be placed in a pilot holding pool, and start dates depend on operational needs and training capacity.

SAS, Scandinavia's leading airline since 1946, operates from its principal hub at Copenhagen Airport (CPH), complemented by hubs in Oslo (OSL) and Stockholm (ARN). Our mission is to connect Scandinavia with the world and the world with Scandinavia. Each year, SAS serves more than 25 million passengers and transports 55 tons of cargo to 135 destinations across Europe, the USA, and Asia. With a passionate workforce of over 10,000 colleagues, we collaborate with partners and customers to drive transformative changes in aviation. We are committed to achieving net-zero emissions by 2050, embodying the visionary spirit of our founders: “To move from the old to what is about to come, is the only tradition worth keeping”. Innovation and societal progress are at the heart of everything we do. For more information, visit our website at www.flysas.com or follow us on social media for the latest updates and promotions.

jobs.occupation: Tjener søges/We Are Hiring Waiters / Waitresses/ restaurant Managers
jobs.description:
🌟 Vi søger tjenere 🌟

Vi søger nye Managere til vores team.

Det vigtigste for os er ikke nødvendigvis mange års erfaring – men at du er et godt menneske med den rigtige indstilling.

Det er en fordel, hvis du taler dansk, men som minimum skal du kunne tale flydende engelsk.

Vi leder efter personer som:• Er søde og positive af natur• Kan arbejde sammen med andre uden drama og konflikter• Har respekt for kollegaer og kunder• Kan holde hovedet koldt når der er travlt• Ser en ære i deres arbejde• Bliver glade når vores kunder er glade• Kan tage ansvar og møde stabilt på arbejde

Hos os betyder stemningen meget. Vi ønsker et team hvor man hjælper hinanden, har respekt for hinanden og sammen giver gæsterne en god oplevelse.

Erfaring er selvfølgelig en fordel, men den rigtige personlighed betyder endnu mere for os.

Send gerne en kort besked om dig selv og din erfaring.

🌟 We Are Hiring Restaurant Manager/ waiters 🌟

We are looking for new waiters and waitresses to join our team.

For us, the most important thing is not necessarily years of experience – but having the right attitude and being a kind person.

Speaking Danish is an advantage, but fluent English is required.

We are looking for people who: • Are naturally kind and positive

• Can work well with others without drama or conflicts

• Treat colleagues and customers with respect

• Can stay calm during busy hours

• Take pride in their work

• Feel happy when customers leave happy

• Are responsible and reliable

The atmosphere in our restaurant is very important to us. We want a team that helps each other, respects each other, and works together to give our guests a great experience.

Experience is a plus, but personality and attitude matter even more to us.

Feel free to send us a short message about yourself and your experience.
